items.exampleEn: The corporation has more than fifty thousand employees.
items.exampleZh: 這家大企業有五萬多名員工。

items.exampleEn: She wrote her name on a label and put it on her lunch box.
items.exampleZh: 她在標籤上寫了名字，貼在她的便當盒上。

items.exampleEn: Cooperation between the two schools has improved a lot this year.
items.exampleZh: 這兩所學校之間的合作今年改善了很多。

items.exampleEn: The two friends ran the shop as a partnership for twenty years.
items.exampleZh: 那兩個朋友合夥經營那家店二十年。

items.exampleEn: The school's recycling scheme has reduced waste by half.
items.exampleZh: 學校的回收計畫讓垃圾量減少了一半。

items.exampleEn: His latest business venture is a pet hotel in the city.
items.exampleZh: 他最新的事業是市區的一家寵物旅館。

items.exampleEn: Shops make a good margin on bottled water.
items.exampleZh: 商店賣瓶裝水的利潤相當不錯。

items.sentenceEn: The label on this bottle has fallen off.
items.sentenceZh: 這個瓶子上的標籤掉了。

items.audioEn: Thanks to the cooperation of all our staff, the move to the new office went smoothly.
items.audioZh: 多虧全體員工的合作，搬到新辦公室的過程很順利。
items.questionZh: 搬到新辦公室為什麼很順利？
options: The new office was very close

items.sentenceEn: The two universities formed a partnership to study climate change.
items.sentenceZh: 那兩所大學建立合作關係，一起研究氣候變遷。

items.sentenceEn: The city started a scheme to give free bikes to students.
items.sentenceZh: 市政府推出一項計畫，免費提供腳踏車給學生。

items.stemEn: We won the game by a narrow ____ of just one point.
items.stemZh: 我們以僅僅一分的些微差距贏了比賽。

items.stemEn: She works for a large ____ with offices in twenty countries.
items.stemZh: 她在一家在二十個國家設有辦公室的大公司上班。

items.passageEn: Two years ago, a Japanese corporation and a small Taiwanese tea farm started a joint venture. The partnership was simple: the farm grew the tea, and the corporation sold it in Japan with a beautiful label designed by local artists. At first, the profit margin was small because shipping was expensive. But with close cooperation, the two partners found cheaper ways to send the tea. They also started a training scheme for young farmers, and the farm recruited ten skilled workers. Some people said the venture was too risky, but last year it made more money than anyone expected.
items.passageZh: 兩年前，一家日本企業和台灣一座小茶園開始了一項合資事業。合作方式很簡單：茶園種茶，企業則把茶包裝上由當地藝術家設計的漂亮標籤，在日本販售。一開始，因為運費很貴，利潤率很低。但經過密切合作，雙方找到了比較便宜的運送方式。他們也為年輕農民開辦了訓練計畫，茶園還招募了十位熟練的工人。有些人說這項事業風險太大，但去年它賺的錢超出了所有人的預期。

questions.questionZh: 一開始利潤為什麼很少？
他們為年輕農民做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 這個計畫需要所有家長的合作。
referenceEn: This project needs the cooperation of all the parents.
This plan needs cooperation from every parent.

items.instructionZh: 用 label 造一個句子，說說你買東西時會看標籤上的什麼資訊。
referenceEn: I always read the label to check the price and size.
I check the label on food to see when it was made.
rubricZh: label 的用法，例如 read the label、the label on… 等
說習慣，時態配合內容（例如 read、always check 等）
